content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-490. - I.P.M.C. Section 302.3.2, Vegetation upon streets or sidewalks.
content.summary:
Section 302.3.2. Vegetation upon streets or sidewalks,
is hereby added to read as follows:
"
302.3.2. Vegetation upon streets or sidewalks.
No person shall permit vegetation or plant growth of any kind to obstruct, grow into
                  or encroach upon streets or sidewalks."
